settings.roof.movingNote: The roof is moving: saves are refused until it stops
settings.roof.mqttChangeGapHint: At rest, a change of the roof's state goes out over MQTT at most this often. 1 to 60 s.
settings.roof.ninaDocLink: How N.I.N.A. opens and closes the roof
settings.roof.ninaUrlHint: The Advanced API (v2) base, http only. Empty: the mount never counts as parked.
settings.roof.notSent: The device sent no roof settings
settings.roof.notStartedHint: A waiting close that doesn't start in time: halt until someone acts, or call it off and try again after the back-off.
settings.roof.openDirectionHint: Which motor direction opens the roof: forward drives RPWM, reverse drives LPWM.
settings.roof.parkHint: The roof closes only onto a parked mount: N.I.N.A. reports it parked and every fitted park switch is closed.
settings.roof.parkHoldHint: The park must be confirmed this long without a break before the roof closes. 4 to 30 s.
settings.roof.parkRequestGapHint: Time between park requests while the device waits for the park. 10 to 120 s.
settings.roof.parkSwitchesHint: Switches that close when the mount is parked: GPIO32, then GPIO33.
settings.roof.parkTimeLimitHint: How long the automatic close waits for the park before a critical alert. A little above your mount's longest park.
settings.roof.rainContactHint: A rain contact on GPIO4. Rain from any source closes the roof.
settings.roof.rampDownHint: Slowing near the end: the zone is the distance covered at the top duty in this time.
settings.roof.rearmHint: After a Stop or a halted close, the automatic close waits this long in safe weather, or for a closed roof. 5 to 60 minutes.
settings.roof.remindHint: A critical alert repeats this often while the roof stays open after it. 10 to 120 minutes; never off.
settings.roof.remoteStop: Remote Stop calls off a close
settings.roof.remoteStopHint: Off: an imaging app or MQTT can't stop a close in unsafe weather. On: their Stop counts as yours, with its critical alert.
settings.roof.slowDutyHint: Duty at the ends and for every move from an unknown position. Not above the top duty.
settings.roof.speedHint: The roof's speed at full duty.
settings.roof.sqmeterMqttHint: Reads SQMeter's safe topic from this device's MQTT broker.
settings.roof.staleAfterHint: SQMeter over HTTP counts as unsafe after this long without a good reply.
settings.roof.stoppedNote: Stopped part-way: saving makes the roof's position unknown
settings.roof.sunAltitudeLimitHint: It is daylight when the sun is at or above this altitude. 0 is sunrise; lower values count twilight; raise it for a high horizon.
settings.roof.timeoutMarginHint: Added to a move's expected time to give its hard timeout.
settings.roof.travelHint: The distance between the two ends.
settings.roof.weatherSourcesHint: Any source that says unsafe makes the weather unsafe, and so does one that is missing or stale.
settingsDeps.remoteCommandsAreOff: Alpaca and MQTT roof commands are off
setup.dismissFailed: Couldn't save: the banner stays until the device answers.
setup.notFinished: Setup isn't finished: the roof may not close itself or alert anyone yet.
setup.offered: A setup wizard can check this roof's essential settings with you.
status.clockHint: Times in alerts wait until the device knows the time.
status.goneQuietHint: It stopped checking without disconnecting. It may have crashed or lost the network.
status.hint: What needs your attention on this device, most important first.
status.noUpdatesHint: No new status for a while. Values may be old.
status.noneOnHint: Turn on a channel to get alerts.
status.sendModeHint: "Only while an imaging app is connected" needs Alpaca, which is off, so alerts go out any time.
status.title: Status
system.diagnosticsHint: A few of advanced diagnostics' live values; the Diagnostics page has the rest and the move log.
system.name: Name
system.setupHint: Walks through the essential settings with live readings and a review. It never moves the roof.
updates.flashABinYouBuilt: Flash a .bin you built yourself. Don't power off or close this tab until the device restarts. For both, upload firmware first, then the web UI.
updates.updateSuccessfulDeviceIsBack: Update successful. Device is back online.
updates.uploadStalled: Upload stalled. Check the WiFi signal, then try again.
validation.configSchema.backOffMustBeBet: Back-off must be between 1 and 30 minutes
validation.configSchema.bandMustBeBetwee: Daylight band must be between 0.1 and 2 degrees
validation.configSchema.changeGapMustBeB: MQTT change gap must be between 1 and 60 s
validation.configSchema.closeGuardMustBe: Close guard must be between 10 and 120 s
validation.configSchema.closeStartMustBe: Close start limit must be between 25 and 120 s
validation.configSchema.daylightModeMust: Daylight: mode must be off, alert or close
validation.configSchema.hostnameCanBeAtM: Hostname can be at most 32 characters
validation.configSchema.httpAuthPassword: HTTP auth password is required when auth is enabled
validation.configSchema.latitudeMustBeBe: Latitude must be between -90 and 90 degrees
validation.configSchema.longitudeMustBeB: Longitude must be between -180 and 180 degrees
validation.configSchema.mqttBrokerAndTop: MQTT broker and topic are required when MQTT is enabled
validation.configSchema.ninaUrlMustStart: N.I.N.A. URL must start with http://
validation.configSchema.parkHoldMustBeBe: Park hold must be between 4 and 30 s
validation.configSchema.parkRequestMustB: Park request spacing must be between 10 and 120 s
validation.configSchema.parkTimeLimitMus: Park: time limit must be between 30 and 1800 seconds
validation.configSchema.publishIntervalC: Publish interval can be at most 24 hours
validation.configSchema.publishIntervalM: Publish interval must be at least 1 second
validation.configSchema.rearmMustBeBetwe: Safe spell must be between 5 and 60 minutes
validation.configSchema.reconnectDelayCa: Reconnect delay can be at most 24 hours
validation.configSchema.reminderMustBeBe: Reminder interval must be between 10 and 120 minutes
validation.configSchema.roofCriticalAler: The roof's critical alerts are Urgent or Wake me
The roof's critical alerts must make a sound
validation.configSchema.setupStateMustBe: Setup state must be new, offered or done
validation.configSchema.setupStepMustBe: Setup page must be between 0 and 10
validation.configSchema.sqmeterUrlMustSt: SQMeter safety URL must start with http://
validation.configSchema.staleTimeMustBeB: Safety: stale time must be between 10 and 600 seconds
validation.configSchema.sunAltitudeMustB: Sun altitude must be between -18 and 30 degrees
validation.configSchema.syncIntervalCanB: Sync interval can be at most 24 hours
validation.configSchema.syncIntervalMust: Sync interval must be at least 10 minutes
validation.configSchema.theAppTokenIsThe: The app token is the 30-character API token of your Pushover application
validation.configSchema.theUserKeyIsThe: The user key is the 30-character key on your Pushover dashboard
validation.configSchema.useLettersNumber: Use letters, numbers and hyphens (not at either end)
Use letters, numbers, _ and -, with / between levels (not at either end)
validation.roofSchema.hallHighMustBeAbov: Roof: the Hall high threshold must be at least 80 counts above the low threshold
validation.roofSchema.slowDutyCantBeAbov: Roof: slow duty can't be above the top duty
wifiSetup.chooseTheNetworkRoofroofShould: Choose the network RoofRoof should join.
wifiSetup.couldnTJoinSsidCheck: Couldn't join {ssid}. Check the password and that the network is in range.
wifiSetup.joinedReconnect: RoofRoof joined {ssid} and is restarting. Join {ssid} on this phone or computer, then open:
wifiSetup.noAnswerFromTheDevice: No answer from the device. If it joined the network, it will restart there.
wifiSetup.theRoofroofSetupHotspotTurns: The RoofRoof-Setup hotspot turns off after the restart.
wizard.alerts.hint: Critical alerts say when the roof couldn't close. They need at least one channel that reaches your phone.
wizard.alerts.noChannel: No alert channel: critical alerts will reach no one.
wizard.alerts.saveToTest: Save to send a test on a channel.
wizard.calibrate.hint: Optional. The wizard never moves the roof: the run has its own page with Stop.
wizard.calibrate.later: You can also run it later from Settings → Roof.
wizard.calibrate.needs: Only with you at the roof, the mount parked, the weather safe and the motor direction checked with a first short move.
wizard.calibrate.title: Calibration run
wizard.calibrate.what: With the motor connected, the controller can open and close the roof slowly and propose the travel, speed, timeout margin and Hall thresholds from what it measures.
wizard.daylight.alert: Alert: an open roof after sunrise is reported; nothing moves.
wizard.daylight.close: Alert and close: the mount is parked and the roof closed after sunrise.
wizard.daylight.needsSite: The daylight check needs the site, on page 2.
wizard.daylight.off: Off: an open roof in daylight is never reported.
wizard.device.hint: The name N.I.N.A. and Home Assistant show for this roof controller.
wizard.device.noPasswordWarning: No password: anyone on your network can change settings and move the roof.
wizard.device.passwordHint: Every change and every roof command asks for it. Without one, anyone on your network can move the roof.
wizard.device.passwordNeeded: Set a password before the motor is connected.
wizard.device.title: This device
wizard.finishFailed: Couldn't finish: the device didn't save it. Try again once the roof is still.
wizard.finished: Setup finished. The motion tests are next, in the commissioning guide.
wizard.hall.hint: The sensor that finds the magnets at the open and closed ends. Hold a magnet to it and watch the reading.
wizard.hall.noAutomaticClose: Without it the roof finds neither end: the automatic close can't work.
wizard.hall.notFittedHint: Leaves the thresholds as they are, to calibrate once the sensor is fitted.
wizard.hall.title: Hall sensor fitted
wizard.hardware.inputsHint: Which switches are fitted, with their live states. Operate each by hand and watch it change.
wizard.hardware.meterAgrees: The reading agrees with your meter within 0.2 V.
wizard.hardware.meterDiffers: Off by {difference} V: check the 100k/22k divider and its wiring.
wizard.hardware.meterReadingHint: What your meter shows at the driver's input. Only compared here, never saved.
wizard.hardware.supplyHint: The supply as the device reads it through its fixed divider. Compare it with a meter at the driver's input.
wizard.heading: Step {number} of {total}: {title}
wizard.motion.hint: Travel and speed set the move's timeout and the slow-down near each end. Measure both while commissioning.
wizard.motion.measureInCommissioning: Measure travel and speed in the commissioning guide's attended moves.
wizard.motion.title: Roof motion
wizard.motion.topDutyHint: The fastest the motor runs. 40% until travel and speed are measured.
wizard.nina.alpacaHint: N.I.N.A. drives the roof as an ASCOM Alpaca Dome. Changing it needs a restart.
wizard.nina.alpacaOff: Alpaca is off: N.I.N.A. can't open or close the roof.
wizard.nina.failsafe: N.I.N.A.'s sequence opens and closes the roof; this device is the failsafe.
wizard.nina.hint: The Advanced API plugin's address. The roof asks it to park the mount and checks the park before closing.
wizard.nina.noUrl: No address: the park can't be confirmed, so the roof can't close itself.
wizard.nina.title: N.I.N.A.
wizard.review.alpacaOff: Alpaca is off: N.I.N.A. can't drive the roof.
wizard.review.alpacaOn: N.I.N.A. can open and close the roof.
wizard.review.clockNotSet: Clock not set: check NTP and the network.
wizard.review.daylightAlerts: An open roof after sunrise is reported.
wizard.review.daylightCloses: The roof is closed after sunrise.
wizard.review.daylightOff: Off: an open roof in daylight is never reported.
wizard.review.hallBetween: Reading between the magnets: check it at each end.
wizard.review.hallNotFitted: Not fitted: the roof can't find either end or close itself.
wizard.review.hallRail: Reading at a rail: the sensor isn't connected.
wizard.review.hint: Each essential setting and reading as the device has it now. Fix any problem before the motor is connected.
wizard.review.motionNotMeasured: Travel and speed are the defaults: measure them while commissioning.
wizard.review.motionSet: Travel and speed set, top duty {duty}%.
wizard.review.motionTestsThere: Test the moves, the timeouts and the dry runs there, with someone at the roof.
wizard.review.mountNotConnected: N.I.N.A. answers, but the mount isn't connected.
wizard.review.nextHint: The wizard never moves the roof. Every move and fault test is done attended, in the commissioning guide.
wizard.review.ninaConnected: N.I.N.A. answers and the mount is connected.
wizard.review.noAlertChannel: No alert channel: critical alerts will reach no one.
wizard.review.noNina: No address: the roof can't close itself.
wizard.review.noParkSwitches: No park switches: the park is confirmed by N.I.N.A. alone.
wizard.review.noPassword: No password: anyone on your network can move the roof.
wizard.review.noReading: No reading from the device yet.
wizard.review.noWeatherSource: No weather source: the roof won't open.
wizard.review.parkSwitchUnreadable: A park switch is unreadable: check its wiring.
wizard.review.parkSwitchesRead: Every fitted switch reads open or closed.
wizard.review.passwordSet: Changes and roof commands need the password.
wizard.review.rainContactRead: The rain contact reads dry or raining.
wizard.review.rainContactUnreadable: Rain contact unreadable: the weather counts as unsafe.
wizard.review.siteNeededForDaylight: Site not set: the daylight check can't run.
wizard.review.siteNotSet: Site not set: needed only if daylight is turned on.
wizard.review.supplyLow: Supply {volts} V < {limit} V: check the supply and the divider.
wizard.review.supplyUnreadable: Supply unreadable: check the sense wire on GPIO36.
wizard.review.title: Checks
wizard.site.hint: Where the roof is, for the sun's altitude the daylight check uses.
wizard.site.notSet: Site not set: the daylight check can't tell day from night.
wizard.site.title: Site
wizard.skipFailed: Couldn't skip: the device didn't save it.
wizard.skipWarning: Unfinished, the roof may not close itself in bad weather or tell anyone.
wizard.skipped: Setup skipped: run it again from the System page.
wizard.test.noNewReading: No new reading within 15 s: check the address and that it's on.
wizard.test.notSaved: Not tested: the page wasn't saved.
wizard.test.waitingForReading: Waiting for the device's next reading.
wizard.weather.noSource: No weather source: the verdict stays unsafe and the roof won't open.
